name: DDRK Flux Conditioning (token reshaping)
plain: Reshapes text-encoder output before sampling. It can scale padding tokens toward zero (only when the encoder supplied an attention mask), multiply the real tokens by a gain, pull each real token's vector norm toward the mean norm, and scale the first, middle and last third of the real tokens. With every control neutral it passes the input through. The thirds are by token position, not meaning. It prints before and after norms.
math:
Symbols: e token embeddings; m attention mask (1 real, 0 pad); A real token count.
pad: e ← e·(m + (1−m)(1 − p)).
gain: e[:A] ← g·e[:A].
norm: n_k = ‖e_k‖, n̄ = mean_k n_k; e_k ← e_k((1 − q) + q·n̄/n_k).
thirds: e[:A/3]·f, e[A/3:2A/3]·m_s, e[2A/3:A]·l.

props.params: pad_attenuation=0, active_gain=1, norm_equalize=0, front_scale=1, mid_scale=1, end_scale=1, report=True

providers.author: HVOSTOVSKY
